verdict: Mixed-condition evaluation on 254 val images (220 PlantVillage lab + 34 field). Combined mAP50=0.9277 reflects real-world generalisation beyond lab conditions. Lab split retained at 0.995 to confirm no catastrophic forgetting of PlantVillage signal. No standalone field-only split exists yet - field val sample (34 images) is too small for a reliable standalone field metric. Next increment: expand field dataset and re-run with --annotated flag to get a dedicated field split.
